bertscore-roberta-large.limitation: Semantic similarity is not factual accuracy or evidence of counterfactual fairness.

identity.reference_policy: both original and oracle values must be extractable
identity.target: oracle value for both changed and preserved facts

fact-changes.limitation: Text-extractable facts only; reference changes are not a separate SCM audit. No pooled score: country and region overlap. No behavioral or fairness claim.

scores.limitations: Text-based extraction reports coverage; unparseable predictions fail scorable references. These checks do not establish behavioral fidelity or counterfactual fairness. The provided flow protocols differ across dimensions.

256.label: 2026-10-24 provided 256-D pipeline; 1,000 labelled reader units; no flow fidelity term

768.label: 2026-10-27 updated 768-D pipeline; 2,000 labelled reader units; flow fidelity 0.1

scores.scope: official test: oracle inversion and predicted-vector end-to-end reconstruction; provided 256-D and 768-D pipelines have different training protocols
scores.selection: S1 flow, predicted reader states, argmax of mean fold probabilities, fixed seed 0. Selected for latent distance in the existing package benchmark; no decoder-output selection.

identity.normalization: collapse whitespace; preserve case and punctuation
identity.scoring_unit: whole CV; no truncation or sentence splitting

vader.limitation: Whole-CV sentiment may saturate; it is not factual accuracy, personality, employability or evidence of counterfactual fairness.
